title: Help & Quick Guides
subtitle: Simple step-by-step instructions for using ArogyaMitra

patientGuide.title: Patient Guide
patientGuide.step1: 1. Create Account & Sign In: Use your username and password to access your health portal safely.
patientGuide.step2: 2. Upload Medical Reports: Tap 'Upload a Medical Report' to add lab tests, blood work, or prescriptions.
patientGuide.step3: 3. Give Doctor Access: Tap 'Give Doctor Access' to allow an attending physician to view your records.

doctorGuide.title: Doctor Guide
doctorGuide.step1: 1. Find Patients: Search by patient name on your home screen or view recent patients.
doctorGuide.step2: 2. Health History: Review a unified chronological timeline of all encounters, labs, and medications.
doctorGuide.step3: 3. Health Insights: Expand Past, Present, Trends, and Possible Risks synthesized by clinical models.
doctorGuide.step4: 4. Care Team Tasks: Delegate vitals collection directly to your allocated care-team nurses.

nurseGuide.title: Nurse Guide
nurseGuide.step1: 1. View Today's Tasks: Check your task queue for pending clinical assignments.
nurseGuide.step2: 2. Accept & Start: Tap 'Accept Task' to claim, then 'Start Task' when attending the patient.
nurseGuide.step3: 3. Record Vitals: Enter blood pressure, pulse, temperature, or glucose.
nurseGuide.step4: 4. Complete Task: Tap 'Complete Task' with clinical observations to update the patient chart.

adminGuide.title: Administrator Guide
adminGuide.step1: 1. Staff Management: Create doctor, nurse, and staff accounts from the People tab.
adminGuide.step2: 2. Care Teams: Allocate nurses to attending physicians to form collaborative care teams.
adminGuide.step3: 3. Document Governance: Review uploaded documents and remove duplicates or inappropriate files with mandatory audit reasons.
